basis: Official PMID41092903 abstract advertises CD8, FOXP3, PD-1 and PD-L1; no all-T-cell CD3 marker is identified there. Sibling workflow cannot be transferred to the candidate or sarcoma by assumption.
clarification: The frozen T-cell localization question is conditional on genuine source cell identity. Until primary methods/marker validation say otherwise, the measurable candidate must be termed CD8-positive cell compartmentalization, not all-T-cell exclusion. Marker presence alone does not prove T-cell lineage, suppressive function, exhaustion, therapy benefit or causal immune mechanism. Tumor/stroma compartments require source-defined validated annotation and areas.
timing: Before any source immune case count, coordinate value, outcome or spatial plot inspection. No biological endpoint values calculated and no favorable comparator selection.
decision_unchanged: Authentic EMC identity, full conditions/controls, public numerical access and useful prior-art distinction remain pending gates; no finding/promotion.
